summary: Dorst Creek (Sequoia NP): NPS API + nps.gov + alerts + rec.gov facility/rules/rates/catalog/availability + imagery. CLOSED all 2026 for storm-damage repair, no reopening date (status written). $32/6 people confirmed; 1-month window, reservation-only, 14-night max; season mid-June..Labor Day; 222 sites (140 of 204 catalogued take 23 ft+); dump confirmed despite one NPS field. Route advisory for >22 ft vehicles noted. Phone option.
flags: STATUS: temporarily_closed written - NPS: 'Not taking reservations in 2026 due to past winter storm damage' and 'does not have a determined reopening date due to ongoing storm damage repair'. rec.gov shows no availability loaded for Dec 2026 or Jun 2027. Keep with the caveat (AWH: add with a caveat, don't withhold).

ACCESS (agency wording, keep): NPS and rec.gov: 'Vehicles longer than 22 feet (including trailers) are not advised between Potwisha Campground and the Giant Forest Museum ... advised to enter via the northern, Highway 180, entrance'. This is a route advisory with an agency-named alternative (Hwy 180), not a campground restriction; NPS says the campground takes 'RVs and trailers of nearly any length, including pull-through sites'. Per the Montana precedent, kept with the route in the note. A 23-ft rig is over 22 ft, so the reviewer may want to see it.

BOOKING: NPS rolling window is ONE month for individual sites (rec.gov reservationWindow 1 Months) - window_opens_days 30 overrides the federal:nps policy row's 180. 'All sites are reservation only' -> fcfs never.
FACILITIES: NPS API amenities list dumpStation 'No', but its own rvInfo and rec.gov both say a dump station is on site - dump true written; reported as a source conflict.
SITES: stored count 218 (note prose) -> 222 (NPS totalSites; 4 group, 12 tent-only). rec.gov catalog has 204 sites, 140 taking an RV/trailer of 23 ft+.

PHONE (option): stored 559-565-3341 is the park's main information line; rec.gov gives the campground's own facility line: 559-565-3341 -> 559-565-4404 ('For facility specific information, please call (559) 565-4404').

WATERFRONT: stored not waterfront kept. rec.gov says 'perched ... on the banks of scenic Dorst Creek', but the loops sit under conifer canopy and no site can be shown within ~50 m of the creek on imagery; marketing wording only. No lead.
PIN: stored 36.63611,-118.80972 (rec.gov facility point) is 184 m from the fit-site centroid 36.63530,-118.81152 - no move.
